item.title: Meta ordered to pay $375M in child exploitation case | Honolulu Star-Advertiser
item.description: A New Mexico jury on Tuesday found Meta Platforms violated state law in a lawsuit brought by the state attorney general, who accused the company of misleading users about the safety of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and of enabling child sexual exploitation on those platforms.

item.title: Senate Republicans block bid to halt Iran war again | Honolulu Star-Advertiser
item.description: WASHINGTON >> For the third time since President Donald Trump began the war against Iran, Senate Republicans on Tuesday blocked an effort by Democrats to terminate the offensive until he wins congressional authorization.
